answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and commits a Semaphore identity in the RLN tree, then evaluates an epoch polynomial whose coefficients bind its nullifier and signing key. A rate-limited duplicate message produces two shares at one epoch point; their polynomial relation reconstructs the private key through Shamir secret sharing, enabling deterministic, instantaneous collateral slashing. The kernel, raven, and reef labels serve only as domain separators, not identities.
